description: This file defines the IdempotencyTokenMiddleware class, which is a part of the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides middleware functionality to automatically generate UUIDv4 tokens for AWS API operations that require idempotency tokens, handling different methods of generating random bytes based on PHP environment capabilities.

classes.name: IdempotencyTokenMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware that auto fills 'idempotencyToken' parameters with a UUID v4 value, used internally within AWS SDK to ensure idempotency in requests.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method to create a middleware wrapper for a given AWS Service, optionally with a custom random bytes generator.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the middleware with next handler, AWS service, and optional custom bytes generator.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware to populate the command with an idempotency token if applicable, generating a UUIDv4 using the configured bytes generator.

methods.name: getUuidV4
methods.description: Generates a UUIDv4 string from 16 bytes of pseudo-random data.

methods.name: findCompatibleRandomSource
methods.description: Detects available PHP functions to generate secure random bytes, prioritizing 'random_bytes', then 'openssl_random_pseudo_bytes', then 'mcrypt_create_iv'.
